Marina — thanks for sending these over and for the clear summary. A couple of quick follow-ups to clear the PO hold: 

1) For a W-8BEN-E claiming treaty benefits we need the completed Part XX (or applicable chapter) clearly referencing the treaty article and the income type — in practice we ask vendors to add a short descriptive line in the form specifying the article number and the reason for the treaty claim (e.g., "Article 12: royalties — software licensing").
2) Please provide the vendor's foreign tax identifier (you included the CRO number — can you also provide the tax authority reference / IRD number if different?)
3) We require a signatory authorization letter on company letterhead (one-page PDF) showing the CFO is authorized to sign tax forms and contracts.

Once we have the updated W-8BEN-E with the treaty article noted, the signatory authorization, and confirmation of the foreign TIN, finance can complete the tax classification and release the PO. I have looped in Lauren in Finance to expedite verification.

If you'd prefer, we can do a 15-min call to walk through the checklist.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Procurement — Redwood Inference
